title: Unify ARIA landmarks and contrast ramp for dense component suite
creator: Maya Chen
description:
Background: As part of the broader Accessibility Stabilization initiative we discovered inconsistent ARIA landmarks, focus treatment, and contrast ramp across compact/dense components (buttons, compact tables, mini charts, token-driven form controls). This ticket unifies semantic landmarks and contrast tokens, implements keyboard-nav improvements, and prepares a conformance evidence pack for VPAT/third-party audits.

Scope: Update design tokens for contrast ramp, define ARIA landmark and role guidance for dense widgets, standardize focus visuals for compact controls, add keyboard interaction patterns for table row navigation and chart legend focus, and assemble VPAT evidence for the affected component set.

Out of scope: Full product-wide VPAT (separate initiative), redesign of visual language, and platform-level runtime changes to serving components (engineering will be enlisted for integration only).
acceptance_criteria: Updated contrast token ramp deployed to design token package with mapping to WCAG targets (AA for normal text, AA large text, 3:1 for non-text UI where applicable)
ARIA guidance document added to component readmes for buttons, compact tables, chart legends and mini-widgets describing landmarks, roles, live regions and aria-label conventions

Keyboard nav patterns implemented in prototypes: arrow-key row movement in compact tables, Enter/Space activation parity for compact buttons, and focusable legend items for charts with clear focus ring
Design documentation includes before/after screenshots and a VPAT evidence folder (tests, screenshots, narrative) exported to confluence
Accessibility QA checklist passes for all listed components in Chrome+VO, Safari+VO, NVDA+Firefox at target contrast settings
design_notes: Contrast: create token set 'a11y-contrast-v2' that maps token names to specific luminance ratios. Use 4.5:1 as baseline for body text, 3:1 for >=18pt (or 14pt bold). Add token aliases for compact component surfaces (surface-compact, surface-compact-pressed) to guarantee contrast against interactive elements.

Focus: define a compact focus treatment that preserves at least 3:1 contrast between ring and adjacent surface. Avoid reducing ring width below 2px for dense controls. Provide CSS variables so runtime can increase thickness when high-contrast mode is enabled.

ARIA: prefer semantic roles (role=button, role=row, role=tablist) over heavy aria-* polyfills. For dense groups that act as a toolbar or set, use role='toolbar' or role='group' with aria-label. For live notifications from charts (e.g., data updates), use aria-live='polite' on a hidden region exposed via token 'live-region-compact'.

Keyboard: tables will support roving tabindex pattern with arrow key navigation and skip-to-row anchors for screen reader users. Chart legends will be focusable with Space/Enter toggling series and will expose state via aria-pressed and aria-controls where appropriate.
implementation_notes: Pairing session scheduled with engineering (runtime & components) to review token variable names and ensure CSS variable fallback across theming layers.
Prototype branch: github.com/redwood-inference/design-system/pull/1987 (WIP) — contains token updates and Storybook stories for compact tables and mini-chart legend keyboard flows.
Figma file: https://www.figma.com/file/r3dW00d/DS-A11Y-compact-ramp — contains annotated frames with contrast calcs and focus states.
Confluence doc: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/DS/Compact+Components+Accessibility+Guidance — will include VPAT evidence export and test scripts.
Coordinate with QA for automated contrast checks (storybook-addon-axe + chromatic visual diffs) and manual SR tests.
qa_plan: Automated: run axe-core checks against updated Storybook stories for compact components; fail build if new violations introduced.
Visual: chromatic snapshots for before/after focus and hover states at default and high-contrast tokens
Manual: checklist for NVDA+Firefox, VoiceOver+Safari, JAWS+IE11 (legacy smoke), including step-by-step scripts for row navigation and chart legend interaction
Regression: run existing VPAT sample prompts against updated components and capture screenshots and narration for evidence pack.
rollout_plan: Merge token changes behind feature flag and deploy to staging stories for a week of compatibility testing
Coordinate with platform engineers to ensure CSS variable names do not conflict with private deployments (add migration notes to release)
Once stable, publish token package update and ship updated component versions as patch releases; update central DS release notes and confluence VPAT folder
Notify product teams with a remediation guide for any product-level overrides that may break contrast or focus rules
